clues.it: Vito era nella 2ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e a nord di Giada.
clues.en: Vito was in the 2nd column, in the 1st row and north of Giada.

clues.it: Luca era nella 3ª colonna, nella 2ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Ugo.
clues.en: Luca was in the 3rd column, in the 2nd row and in a different room from Ugo.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 4ª riga, accanto a un barile e a nord di Ugo.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 4th row, beside a barrel and north of Ugo.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 10ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Nino.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 10th column, in the 5th row and in a different room from Nino.

clues.it: Rosa era a ovest di Nino e sul Ponte.
clues.en: Rosa was west of Nino and on the Deck.

clues.it: Giada era accanto a uno scaffale e in Cambusa, ma non era accanto a una lanterna.
clues.en: Giada was beside a shelf and in the Galley, but was not beside a lantern.

clues.it: Dario era l'unica persona su una corda e accanto a una pianta, ma non era accanto a una corda.
clues.en: Dario was the only person on a rope coil and beside a plant, but was not beside a rope coil.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 9ª riga, accanto a una rete e a ovest di Dario.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 9th row, beside a net and west of Dario.

clues.it: Carla era nella 7ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Dario.
clues.en: Carla was in the 7th column and in the same room as Dario.

clues.it: Nino era nella 11ª colonna, accanto a una corda e in una stanza diversa da Fabio.
clues.en: Nino was in the 11th column, beside a rope coil and in a different room from Fabio.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 9th row: ruling it out leaves Giada a single square: row 7th, column 6th.
